starters.title: Pricing Model Transition Strategy
starters.summary: Achieve Net Revenue Retention Above 110% While Enabling Bottom-Up Adoption
starters.brief: We're considering moving from per-seat pricing to usage-based pricing across our whole customer base. The options are a full switch at renewal, a hybrid platform-fee-plus-usage model, or leaving existing customers on seats and only selling usage to new logos. Our largest ten accounts are 40% of revenue and several of them would pay less under usage pricing. We need to protect net revenue retention above 110% while making the product easier to adopt bottom-up.
